up-vbcc: parts, licences and where the source is

Part                                Licence                                                                                                                             Source
----------------------------------  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
vbcc, vasm, vlink, target (vbcc/)   vbcc, vasm, vlink: redistributable unmodified, non-commercial use (commercial use of m68k AmigaOS output allowed) (licenses/vbcc)   the author's archives, unmodified: phoenix.owl.de/vbcc/current (upterm-ports pkgs/vbcc)

Notes
- The two lha archives (SHA-256 pinned) are in up-term-src.lha, published next to up-term.lha. Their
  row of SOURCES.txt is in UP-Term:licenses/vbcc/SOURCES.txt.
- The Amiga NDK is not part of this package.
